# OJOOK

> OJOOK is an eco-friendly oral care brand combining Korean traditional ingredients like bamboo salt and nano-hydroxyapatite with sustainable, plastic-free products.

OJOOK specializes in natural toothpaste formulations featuring nano-hydroxyapatite (nHA) and Korean Jukyeom (bamboo salt) for enamel remineralization and gum health. The brand emphasizes Eastern wellness philosophy, EWG verification, and sustainable packaging across toothpastes, floss, and bamboo toothbrushes for families.

## Key Topics

- Nano-hydroxyapatite (nHA)
- Korean bamboo salt (Jukyeom)
- Fluoride-free toothpaste
- Enamel remineralization
- EWG Verified
- Eco-friendly oral care
- Sustainable packaging
- Natural ingredients
- FSC-certified bamboo
- Cavity prevention
- Kids oral care
- Biodegradable silk floss
- Eastern wellness philosophy
- Plastic-free living
- Subscription products

## Core Products

- [Korean Bamboo Salt Toothpaste with Nano Hydroxyapatite (nHA)](https://ojookcare.com/products/nano-hydroxyapatite-and-bamboo-salt-toothpaste): Flagship OJOOK toothpaste product with nHA and Korean bamboo salt for enamel remineralization
- [Nano Hydroxyapatite & Bamboo Salt Toothpaste (3-Pack Bundle)](https://ojookcare.com/products/nha-bamboo-salt-toothpaste-3pack): 3-pack toothpaste bundle with nHA and 9x roasted Korean bamboo salt
- [Kids Korean Bamboo Salt Toothpaste with nHA - Pure Dew](https://ojookcare.com/products/kids-bamboo-salt-toothpaste-with-nha-pure-dew): EWG-verified kids toothpaste with nHA, fluoride-free for ages 0-12
- [Biodegradable Silk Floss Refill 2-pack with Korean Bamboo Salt](https://ojookcare.com/products/bamboo-salt-silk-floss-refill-2-pack): Eco-friendly biodegradable silk floss with bamboo salt and beeswax
- [Bamboo Toothbrush 2-pack - Plastic Free Living](https://ojookcare.com/products/intention-setting-bamboo-toothbrush-2-pack-value-pack): Eco-friendly bamboo toothbrush 2-pack with intention-setting handle
